name: Stranded Dick
source:
After graduating from high school, you and your classmates rent a yacht to celebrate your last summer together. During one night, an accident occurs and the yacht starts catching fire and, even though you try to extinguish it, you end up jumping into the rough sea. Not knowing how, you end up on an uninhabited island, or at least is what you think.

Now you will have to try to stay alive while you search for other survivors and figure out how you'll be rescued. Will you be able to survive during this adventure? And more important, Will you be able to seduce all the women around? It's up to you…

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sexandgames/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
高中毕业后，你和你的同学租了一艘游艇，一起庆祝最后一个夏天。一天晚上，发生了事故，游艇开始着火，尽管你试图扑灭它，但你最终还是跳进了波涛汹涌的大海。不知道如何，你最终来到了一个无人居住的岛屿，或者至少是你所认为的。

现在你必须努力活下去，同时寻找其他幸存者并弄清楚如何获救。你能在这次冒险中生存下来吗？更重要的是，你能诱惑周围所有的女人吗？这取决于你……
